text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 02 · 舷窗旁的远航卧舱.
Environment:  A cozy long-voyage spaceship sleeping cabin, built-in cream upholstered bed on the left, small walnut writing ledge, closed storage lockers and folded cotton bedding, broad oval porthole on the right revealing a small blue planet above its sunlit limb. Close room-scale view across the empty bedside floor. Soft practical lamps balanced with planet bounce, restrained futuristic comfort.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 4 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 02 · 舷窗旁的远航卧舱. A 2x2 sheet of FOUR distinct eye-level camera views of the SAME ONE space: original forward direction, a lateral oblique view, a reverse view 180 degrees opposite, and the other lateral view. Labels A B C D only. Preserve ALL door/window/furniture positions; actually move camera, never mirror the building. Same material and lighting. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions.
